# CDRElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCDRElement` · **Group:** [Codes and documents](../Groups/Codes-and-documents.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/Plugins/Vector/CDR/UltraCanvasCDRPlugin.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/Plugins/Vector/CDR/UltraCanvasCDRPlugin.h) · `#include "Vector/CDR/UltraCanvasCDRPlugin.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## Overview

UI element that displays CDR content

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasCDRExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasCDRExamples.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCDRElement> CreateCDRElement( const std::string& identifier, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCDRElement(const std::string& identifier, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onPageChanged` | `std::function<void(int)> onPageChanged` | _Page changed_ |
| `onLoadError` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onLoadError` | _Load error_ |
| `onLoadComplete` | `std::function<void()> onLoadComplete` | _Load complete_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

### struct `CDRExportResult`

Outcome of a "save as" conversion (see UltraCanvasCDRPlugin::ExportToSVG / ExportToXAR). On success writtenFiles lists every file created; on failure error says why and writtenFiles is empty.
